main.description: A post in a thread: a thread's opening post, a chat message, a forum reply or a comment on an article alike. Written by its author. A thread's opening post (OP) is its author's first post in it that answers no other post. A channel's untitled chat is the posts whose thread is the channel's own thread record.

thread.description: The root this post belongs to (the root in Bluesky, Barazo and Coves terms): a garden.msg.thread, or any site.standard.document when the post is a comment on an article.

replyTo.description: The post this one answers (the parent in Bluesky, Barazo and Coves terms). Absent on a top-level post, where those lexicons set parent to the root. Apps may show replies flat (forum, chat) or nested (comments), and can rebuild the tree from thread plus replyTo.

document.description: A site.standard.document that is the same piece of writing, such as a thread's opening post that is also a blog post, or a long reply republished as an article. Only counts when the document is in the same repo and links back with garden.msg.defs#link.

textContent.description: Plain-text rendering of the post. Required, so every reader can show every post. Should not contain markdown or other formatting.

content.description: The post in a rich format. Open union: garden.msg.defs#markdown is the shared format every threads app should be able to read and write; apps may use their own formats, but should still write textContent.

updatedAt.description: When the post was last edited.
